title: OutreachResultEvent
description: One external (ChatGPT/Gmail-side) result event, appended to data/outreach/outreach_results.jsonl (local fallback) for scripts/import_outreach_results.py to apply idempotently. Lead Engine never produces these -- they represent real Gmail-side reconciliation/send/reply/bounce outcomes, which only Gmail (via ChatGPT) can observe. Never fabricated by this repository.

lead_id.description: Must match a lead_id already present in the shared handoff queue

event_at.description: When the underlying Gmail-side fact was actually observed -- used for newer-wins ordering, never the import time

reason.description: Required in practice for a SUPPRESSED event (e.g. BOUNCE, NEGATIVE_REPLY, UNSUBSCRIBE) -- see config/outreach.yaml: suppression_reasons

source.description: e.g. 'chatgpt_gmail_reconciliation' -- never a claim of Lead Engine's own origin
